reviewed_auxiliary_inputs.purpose: use the reviewed exact-source/numeric semantics when materializing precision-bound fixtures; MC-003 is not added as a graph dependency

frozen_before_candidate_qualification: workload profile identities and deterministic generation seed
freeze_policy.allowed_prospective_change: new reviewed version only, with old profile retained and no use of the revision to retroactively pass an already observed failure

workload_generation.material_change_count_definition: count an independently established positive-volume nominal material-set change; journal events, source samples, canonical segments and adapter counters are reported separately and cannot substitute
workload_generation.redundant_history_definition: valid retained source history that produces zero additional nominal removed volume after prior state; kept separate from geometry-changing counts
workload_generation.fixture_materialization_rule: materialized fixture bytes, generator revision and source hashes are frozen before candidate execution; later regeneration requires a new profile version

workload_profiles.purpose: tiny correctness and boundary controls before any broad run
complete admitted-domain and precision/topology boundary qualification
workload_profiles.coverage: at least one valid fixture for every ID in required_operation_coverage, plus invalid physical controls that do not contribute to valid-case pass rates

requirements.material_state: no known positive-volume material may be deleted, invented or silently dropped
requirements.body_identity_and_count: exact under the durable-body/regularized-material contract, including explicit empty state
requirements.topology_events: required connectivity/split/disappearance events must agree with the independent certificate/oracle contract
requirements.invalid_case_handling: invalid physical controls must be rejected for the stated reason and cannot count as solved valid cases

requirements.small_feature_rule: the absolute spatial limit does not authorize deleting or merging a positive-volume feature; topology/material semantics remain governed by A-SEMANTIC
requirements.uncertainty_rule: nominal algorithmic error and source/measurement uncertainty are reported separately and may not be combined to hide a known nominal failure

requirements.purpose: candidate-blind precision stress on selected representable fixtures; failure remains visible and cannot be converted into a domain exclusion

primary.notes: exact motherboard, firmware, OS, compiler and dependency manifest must be recorded at execution time; a faster substitute may be reported additionally but may not replace this reference without a prospective contract revision

secondary_baseline.role: non-gating practical baseline and regression comparison

verdict_policy.required_valid_case_pass_rule: all applicable semantic, geometry, reconstruction/output and resource requirements for the current gate must pass; finite pass percentage cannot compensate for one unresolved required valid case

measurements: expression nodes/cells/mesh elements/B-rep faces/edges as applicable

open_questions.status: requires measured need and separate explicit authorization; not a prerequisite for MC-004 artifact completion
must be verified at campaign time; no old or guessed price is frozen into this contract
